meta.notes: chits: 12 per character, stage = development level 1-4 of the chit, strength null for Magic chits. stage4 = the normal-game start. startGold is the recorded gold (10); startValue = 10 + gold prices of starting weapons/armor (digest 05 2.1). spellTypes = the Roman numerals of the character's Magic chits. relationships use -2..+2 and keys of native groups or visitors; unlisted groups are Neutral. advantages are own-words paraphrases (digest 05 2.2 order). optionalChits holds the Wizard optional-rule chit. Wizard stage 2/3 chit placement differs between RealmSpeak and the digest; RealmSpeak placement kept.
